thread:
maria: Heads-up — our token-level latency dashboard just showed a sharp spike for route /v1/chat: +30% p50 and +70% p99 starting ~08:00 UTC. Correlated with a rise in function/tool-call validation time and KV-cache miss rate.
alex: saw that too. Is this across all models or just the 13B family?
sanjay: quick query — looks concentrated on distill-13B-quant / default kernel. 35% of requests hit the new kernelchooser path.
paula: possible recent change: yesterday we tweaked kernel selection to prefer fast-fp16 kernels for sequences <256. Could be misclassifying some longer sequences if prefix trimming happened.
maria: also noticed KV-cache eviction count climbed around the same time. Could be batching heuristics causing smaller batches and more cache churn.
alex: can someone paste the perf flame/log? I have a guess about validation overhead in tool-call wrapper.
paula: snippet from the dashboard logs:
```
[08:03:12] request_id=abc123 route=/v1/chat model=distill-13B-quant kernel=fast-fp16 seq=320 batch_size=1 kv_lookup=miss validation_ms=45 generator_ms=120 total_token_ms=170
[08:03:12] request_id=abc124 route=/v1/chat model=distill-13B-quant kernel=fast-fp16 seq=64 batch_size=8 kv_lookup=hit validation_ms=12 generator_ms=60 total_token_ms=82
```
sanjay: validation_ms is the function-call/tool validation (schema + permission checks) — 45ms is elevated. We usually see 8–15ms.
infra-bot: deploy-notice: kernelchooser v2 rolled at 07:50 UTC to 20% of traffic (rollout-id: kc-v2-2026-03-18)
alex: that rollout timing matches. KC v2 probably changed the kernel mapping and batching policy simultaneously.
maria: hypothesis: KC v2 selects fast-fp16 for some longer sequences, which increases per-token decode work due to kernel mismatch, and also misaligns batching windows leading to smaller batch sizes -> more KV-cache misses -> more validation calls per token.
paula: another path: the validation layer might be retriggering on retries if a structured-output schema check fails. Do we have retry counts?
sanjay: yes — retries for function calls up 4x on that route. Many of the retries are due to schema normalization rejects (edge case with nested arrays).
alex: action items:
- revert kernelchooser rollout (paula)
- add telemetry: per-request kernel chosen, batch size, kv_hit boolean, validation_ms, retry_count (sanjay)
- add a histogram of validation_ms by schema type (maria)
- run a targeted canary comparing KC v1 vs v2 on token-level latency (devops)
paula: started rollback to 0% for kc-v2 (in progress).
infra-bot: deploy action: kc-v2 rollback initiated by paula at 08:11 UTC (status: in-progress)
devops: I'll spin a perf A/B harness to replay 1K previously failing conversations against both kernels and capture token breakdown.
maria: until we have the telemetry, add a temporary metric: increment counter when validation_ms > 30ms and include kernel tag. We'll use it to tune the validation circuit breaker.
sanjay: also adding a KV-cache eviction tag per prefix key to see if certain prompt templates are thrashing the cache.
alex: note — caching is per-model+kernel. If KC v2 changed kernel, the same cache keys won't hit. That alone could explain kv miss jump.
paula: rollback completed at 08:18 UTC. early signs: p50 reduced ~10%. Need more data.
maria: will deploy the temporary metrics now and roll a micro-dashboard widget for the next hour.
devops: replay started (1k convs) — initial run shows validation_ms median 14ms on KC v1, 40ms on KC v2 for convs with nested tool args.
sanjay: ok this points to KC v2 causing more tool-call validation latency (maybe different code path or serialization). Let's gate kernelchooser changes behind the schema-validation fast path.
alex: can we short-circuit validation for read-only tool calls that only need arg-level typing? Might shave 10–20ms.
paula: agreed. I'll propose a PR to the tool-runner to add lightweight preflight checks + memoization keyed by normalized-schema-hash.
maria: summary: rollback done, telemetry tasks assigned, A/B replay confirms validation delta. We'll reconvene after we have the per-request kernel+kv+validation logs (in ~60min). Thanks all :thumbsup:
alex: +1
sanjay: thanks, digging in on schema normalizer.
paula: ping me if you see regressions in other routes.
infra-bot: incident-note: perf spike incident opened (INC-2026-0318-01) assigned to eng-runtime.
maria: closing loop here — next update in #eng-runtime in 45–60m with dashboard link.
